notes.notes: - Performance improvements, which mainly impacts Planet 4 where a lot is happening, especially at higher levels. Still work-in-progress, but it should run a lot smoother than before.

notes.title: Mining Survivors: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,



The release date for Mining Survivors will be August 15th 2025.



The full game will feature two modes:

- Incremental

- Roguelike



Incremental mode features a definitive end-point to the campaign, but the ability to continue playing and prestiging if you choose.



Roguelike mode provides a more bite-sized challenge, with full runs lasting about 20-30 mins.



Thanks to everyone who's checked out the demo and given feedback - I hope you enjoy the full game!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has played the Mining Survivors Demo, and to those who have given feedback!

My main focus is to smooth out any aspects of the progression system that feel frustrating or punishing, especially in the early game.

Here are the latest updates:

- Ability to choose your starting weapon by spending Coal
- Easier enemies at the start of Level 1
- Weapon guaranteed within the first 2 XP rewards
- Stat description when hovering
- More generous Melee upgrades with Iron
- Some minor bug fixes

Cheers,
Wonderbounce Games
